name: After recital E
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text: Ea. whereas between November 2024 and October 2025, protest activities included 25 172 unregistered rallies, 13 138 unregistered roadblocks across junctions and major roads, over 750 attacks on offices of the ruling Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) and over 170 police officers were injured;
